context: Request: the most recent data-breach matter the firm has handled, as a rapid-response reference. Rubric: 1008-00009 (Lumos Analytics credential-stuffing response, 2024) as the answer, plus a precision criterion that fails if another matter (e.g. 1025-00006, Quorum/Palomar 2023 incident response) is asserted as qualifying.

stages.note: Counts and lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path regex for request words grouped per matter (89 matters); a grep-tool search over text files returns nothing.

stages.note: Lists all files of two candidate matters.

stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads engagement, assessment, notification and closing documents of the two dedicated matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Names the later matter as the most recent and describes the earlier dedicated matter as another confirmed matter of the requested kind.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks cited paths; no change.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the openings of three cited documents and the response; no change.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It named the most recent matter but described an earlier dedicated matter as also qualifying.

first_error.why: It read both dedicated matters (evidence seen at [36]-[42]) and named the later one, but the answer also presents the earlier matter as another comparable engagement of the requested kind.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The last check review said not to add non-qualifying matters as secondary precedents; the agent finished without re-reading the comparison wording.

divergence: All three failed the same way at the write stage: each found and read both dedicated matters, correctly named the later one as most recent, and described the earlier one as another qualifying matter. No review named the qualifying wording; in T0 and T1 the last check review said to keep the earlier matter as a comparison (T1: do not remove it), and in T2 the last review gave a stock warning against non-qualifying secondary precedents. All check stages only re-read sources and the response.
